verdict.rationale: The pack shows Azure has managed identities that let applications obtain Entra tokens without managing credentials (azure-docs-12) and RBAC for fine-grained access (azure-docs-10/11), which is directly relevant to eliminating long-lived credentials, but there is no documentation in the pack specifically covering OIDC/workload identity federation for CI pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions to Azure) or short-lived credential issuance end-to-end for CI/service workflows. missing for 10: explicit workload identity federation/OIDC docs for CI systems, end-to-end setup guide, and independent verification that short-lived tokens are actually issued to CI.
